records.subject: FS
records.title: Introduction to Food Science
records.description: Chemistry, microbiology, and processing of food and food products; concepts of food preservation, packaging and marketing of foods; world food issues. Field trip may be required.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Science on Your Plate
records.description: Overview of the basic science behind foods; explores the discoveries, inventions, myths, and misconceptions related to foods; examines the evolution of foods and government regulations for conventional and organic foods.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Science on Your Plate - Laboratory
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: FS 201 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Basic processing and analysis of common foods; tour of WSU Creamery and Dairy Farm; how to make cheese, ice cream, yogurt, and kefir.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Food Safety and Quality
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite:  CHEM 105; CHEM 106; BIOLOGY 107.
records.description: Regulation, safety, and wholesomeness of food products; microbiological, chemical, and physical risks associated with food; hazard analysis as related to food safety, processing and quality; sanitation and pest management principles; methods for analyzing the sensory qualities of food products; problem management associated with food quality assurance.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Unparsed source wording: CoursePrerequisite:

records.subject: FS
records.title: Food Mycology
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MBIOS 101 or concurrent enrollment, or MBIOS 304 and 305, either with concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Survey of the fungi important in food production, storage, and spoilage. (Crosslisted course offered as FS 301, PL P 301.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Cereal Chemistry and Processing
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHEM 345.
records.description: Cereal and legume structure, chemistry, and function as it relates to processing and utilization.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Unparsed source wording: CoursePrerequisite:

records.subject: FS
records.title: Dairy Foods Composition and Quality
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: FS 110; CHEM 345.
records.description: Introduction to the dairy processing industry: chemistry of milk components; standards of identity of dairy products; quality control tests of fluid milk; microbiology of fluid milk; organoleptic properties of fluid milk; chemical changes during storage; federal, state, and international regulations applied to dairy foods; leaning and sanitation in dairy manufacturing plants; dairy effluents and waste management. Two 1-day field trips required.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Unparsed source wording: CoursePrerequisite:

records.subject: FS
records.title: Instrumental and Sensory Analysis of Food
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHEM 106; FS 110 or 201; STAT 212 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Evaluation of the chemical and physical properties of foods including both sensory and instrumental analysis.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Topics in Food Science
records.description: Selected topics in food science.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Industrial Fermentations
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHEM 470 or MBIOS 303; MBIOS 101 or 305.
records.description: Science and technology associated with industrial-scale food fermentations.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Unparsed source wording: CoursePrerequisite:

records.subject: FS
records.title: Ciders and Other Fermented Foods
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: BIOLOGY 106 and 107, or MBIOS 101, or MBIOS 304 and 305.
records.description: Chemistry, microbiology, and technology associated with the production of cider, beer, and other food fermentations.  Recommended preparation: FS 304 and 465. (Crosslisted course offered as FS 405, ANIM SCI 405.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Mixed AND/OR scope needs review

records.subject: FS
records.title: Evaluation of Dairy Products
records.description: Identifying attributes of different dairy products caused by production, processing, and storage issues; determining probable cause of those attributes and how to reduce their occurrence. Recommended preparation: FS 329; FS 429; FS 430.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Evaluation of Dairy Products Lab
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: FS 406 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Identifying defects in dairy products and intense training for Collegiate Dairy Products Evaluation Competition.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Principles of Environmental Toxicology
records.description: Nature, properties, effects, and detection of toxic substances in the environment and in environmentally exposed species, including humans. Recommended preparation: BIOLOGY 102 or 107; CHEM 102; CHEM 105; CHEM 106; STAT 212. Credit not granted for both FS 409 and 509.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Food Microbiology
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MBIOS 101, or MBIOS 304 and 305.
records.description: Purpose for enumeration, detection and identification of microorganisms in food products; physical, chemical and environmental factors influencing growth and survival of foodborne microorganisms; pathogenic and spoilage microorganisms in food and their control.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Mixed AND/OR scope needs review

records.subject: FS
records.title: Food Microbiology Laboratory
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Concurrent enrollment in FS 416.
records.description: Methods for enumeration, detection, and identification of spoilage and pathogenic microorganisms in foods.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Oral Seminar in Food Science
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite:  Admitted to the major in Food Science; junior standing.
records.description: Development of skills and communication tools and techniques for oral presentations of current food science research; professional development and job preparation.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Dairy Processing
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MBIOS 303 or CHEM 470; 4 credits of PHYSICS 101, or PHYSICS 101 and 111.
records.description: Basic dairy chemistry, microbiology, and processing from cow to consumer; dairy quality, safety, and sanitation; milk components, fluid milk, concentrated milk, cream, butter, ice cream, fermented milk, cheese, and dairy powders. Recommended preparation: FS 110 or VIT ENOL 113. Credit not granted for both FS 429 and FS 529.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Dairy Processing Lab
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: FS 429 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Hands-on training in processing of various dairy products (e.g., fluid milk, butter, ice cream, cheese, and yogurt); milk pick-up and raw milk quality; cleaning and sanitation of dairy plants. Credit not granted for both FS 430 and FS 530.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Food Engineering
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 140 or 171; 4 credits of PHYSICS 101, or PHYSICS 101 and 111.
records.description: Food engineering for improving the efficiency of food processing operations and quality processed food; heat transfer, stream, air-vapor mixtures, refrigeration and fluid flow.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Food Engineering Lab
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: FS 432 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: To enhance the learning experience of the students taking FS 432 through laboratories, problem sessions and group discussions.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Principles of Sustainability
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Junior standing.
records.description: Issues and processes in sustainability; resource management, waste generation and management; industrial approaches to sustainability; case studies.  Credit not granted for both FS 436 and 536.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Food Laws
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: FS 110, FS 201, or FS 220.
records.description: Government statutes and regulations that contribute to a safe, nutritious, and wholesome food supply; the law and the US legal system relevant to the regulation of the manufacture and sale of food and supplements, including jurisdictional issues, administrative law, and tort, contract, corporate, environmental, labor, and criminal law issues. (Formerly FS 516.) Credit not granted for both FS 440 and FS 540.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Unparsed source wording: CoursePrerequisite:

records.subject: FS
records.title: Food Processing
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: FS 110; FS 220; FS 432; concurrent enrollment in FS 443; STAT 212 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Specialized techniques, concepts and practices of food processing. (Formerly FS 303.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Food Processing Lab
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Concurrent enrollment with FS 442.
records.description: Application of specialized techniques, concepts and practices of food processing.  Field trip required. (Formerly FS 302.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Advanced Instrumental and Sensory Analysis of Food
records.description: Advanced evaluation of the chemical and physical properties of foods including both sensory and instrumental analysis. Credit not granted for both FS 450 and 550.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Food Chemistry
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHEM 345; CHEM 470 or MBIOS 303.
records.description: Fundamentals of food chemistry; composition of foods and the changes that occur during processing.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Unparsed source wording: CoursePrerequisite:

records.subject: FS
records.title: Food Chemistry Laboratory
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: FS 460 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Experiments related to the properties, reactions and interactions of chemical components of foods.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Food Toxicology
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite:  CHEM 470 or MBIOS 303.
records.description: General principles of toxicological evaluation of chemicals which enter the food chain; toxicology of food additives, colors, preservatives, drugs, pesticides and natural toxins in foods and risk characterization. Credit not granted for both FS 464 and FS 564.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Unparsed source wording: CoursePrerequisite:

records.subject: FS
records.title: Wine Microbiology and Processing
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHEM 470 or MBIOS 303; MBIOS 101 or 305.
records.description: Technical principles related to the processing and fermentation of wines with an emphasis on microbiology. Recommended preparation for graduate students: CHEM 370 or MBIOS 303; MBIOS 304; MBIOS 101 or 305. Credit not granted for both FS 465 and FS 565.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Unparsed source wording: CoursePrerequisite:

records.subject: FS
records.title: Wine Microbiology and Processing Laboratory
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: FS 465 or concurrent enrollment; MBIOS 101 or 304.
records.description: Hands-on winemaking; application of chemical microbiological methods for wine analysis. Field trip required. (Crosslisted course offered as FS 466, VIT ENOL 466).
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Advanced Food Technology
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: FS 302; FS 303.
records.description: Physical principles of food preservation and recent advances in food technology. Recommended preparation:  FS 416; FS 432; FS 460. Credit not granted for both FS 470 and FS 570.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Unparsed source wording: CoursePrerequisite:

records.subject: FS
records.title: Quality Management Tools for Food Products
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: FS 442 or concurrent enrollment; FS 443 or concurrent enrollment; STAT 212 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Fundamental concepts for quality management and improvement of bio manufactured goods, and application of principles of statistical process control in a variety of situations and systems.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Food Product Development
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: FS 302; FS 303; FS 416; FS 460; senior standing.
records.description: Course serves as a capstone experience for food science seniors, and will require the application of food chemistry, food processing/engineering, and microbiology course knowledge in formulating a new food product.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Internship in Food Science
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Sophomore standing.
records.description: Students work full time in industrial assignments with prior approval of advisor and industrial supervisor.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: FS
records.title: Internship in a Winery
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Sophomore standing.
records.description: Industrial assignments at a regional, national or international winery.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.title: Special Problems
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: By department permission.
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
